high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from "ET Online," dated June 1, 2025, at 01:25 PM IST. The article discusses LinkedIn co-founder Reid Hoffman's criticism of the Trump administration's decision to suspend all new student visa interviews. The text highlights Hoffman's view that this move is damaging for the U.S. education system and its ability to attract international talent. Reid Hoffman is quoted as saying, "Unfortunately, the truth. Other countries are moving to fill the gap and acquire top talent. We've completely forgotten how America prospered.
